The Harvard Crimson (1 September 2022): the mother of Rodrigo Ventocilla Ventosilla, a 32-year-old trans man, Harvard Kennedy School student and co-founder of a Peruvian trans-rights group, says he was beaten by police after his arrest at Bali's international airport on marijuana charges and died in custody in Denpasar on 26 August 2022; his spouse, who returned to Peru, alleges physical and psychological violence with evidence of torture; Bali police deny any violence; Indonesia's drug laws provide up to 12 years for possession.
